verdicts.note: Rests on one bill (co-sponsorship plus floor vote on ESHB 1296) and no statements. The bill rewrote and narrowed I-2081's parents' rights list rather than eliminating notification and opt-outs, so it is a moderate move toward pole_b, not the full pole. Sponsoring the bill adds confidence but doesn't move the score further. This keeps him in line with Frame and Street, who are at +1 for a vote on the same bill.
